assets.prompt: Production premium MOBA user interface icon atlas EXACT FOUR COLUMNS x FIVE ROWS. All 20 icons equal square size, dark navy backgrounds, thin restrained antique gold square frames, no text, no labels. Portrait canvas 4:5. Each column belongs to one original character, left to right: Aegis: female solar paladin in heavy ivory and gold plate armor, sun-emblem round shield and a straight golden sword, crimson cloak; Bolt: bulky brass and navy mechanical golem, oversized articulated metal fists, teal power core and steam exhaust, squat broad proportions; Saur: large emerald crocodile warrior, gold desert plate armor, massive crescent bladed poleaxe, digitigrade tail; Lancer: male noble spear duelist in burgundy and silver armor, long black ponytail, broad bladed silver spear. Row1 tightly framed shoulder/head character portraits. Row2 four iconic Q abilities respectively: shield bash thrust; punch open fist forward; spin crescent blade sweeping; three spear thrusts. Row3 W: sun armor flares; steam speed overdrive; double cleaver strike; long spear sweep and thrust. Row4 E: sword forward radiant reach; uppercut hydraulic fist; low lunging blade dash; forward spear charge. Row5 R: raise sword calling down solar column; radial blue electrical discharge; grow with crimson fury aura; radial spear sweep. Readable detailed game ability icons, strong silhouette, jewel colors matching hero, crisply rendered weapon or magical motif centered in each square. All five rows and all four columns mandatory.
